Built against [wamsoft/krkrz_dev](https://github.com/wamsoft/krkrz_dev) V2.6.5

- **Effekseer effects**: the new `efk` flip type plays [Effekseer](https://effekseer.github.io/) effects (`.efk`, `.efkefc`, `.efkzip`) on World layers (`[newlay name=fx efk=sparkle show]`) and KAG layers (`[image layer=0 flip=sparkle.efk]`). Options set the size, canvas, start frame, position, tilt and rotation, zoom, speed, colour, looping, triggers and dynamic inputs; `efkstop` lets an effect wind down, and the `efkdone` trigger goes when every effect has ended. Effects are kept in save data. See `doc/world.txt` and `doc/kagex.txt`
- The sample has an Effects demo in its demo menu, with five effects of its own: glowing petals, sparkles, fireworks, a magic circle and a shockwave. `tools/assets/make_effects.py` makes them. The demo replaces the fire effect, which needed a plugin the SDL engine doesn't have
- Effects work on Windows, Linux, macOS, Android and the web build. The iOS build doesn't have the plugin yet, so effects show nothing there (the console says why)
- A World layer's colour change (such as `[env grayscale=true]`) no longer restarts an effect on it
- kagex-release keeps the textures and sounds an effect names in their own format, since the effect can't be rewritten to name converted files
- kagex-release 0.4.0 downloads the 0.4.0 engines

Everything in this release is listed in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/krkren/kagex/blob/0.4.0/CHANGELOG.md).

On Windows the engine needs OpenGL ES: a graphics driver that supports it, or ANGLE's `libEGL.dll` and `libGLESv2.dll` next to `krkrz.exe`.

The macOS app and tool aren't signed with an Apple Developer ID, so macOS blocks them the first time: open the app from the context menu (Open), or allow it under System Settings > Privacy & Security; for the tool, `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine kagex-release`. The Android APK is signed with a debug key: allow installs from unknown sources, or use `adb install`. The sample's iOS build is for the Simulator; kagex-release signs a game for iPhones and iPads with your own Apple Developer certificate.
